interface.signature: canMeasureWater(x: int, y: int, z: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: All inputs are non-negative integers representing jug capacities and target volume.
The target volume z cannot exceed the combined capacity of the two jugs.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (z == 0 or (z <= x + y and z % math.gcd(x, y) == 0))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if z is zero or z is a non-negative integer multiple of the greatest common divisor (gcd) of x and y, and z does not exceed the combined capacity of the jugs.
